caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate vessel, resembling a pitcher or jug, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige background. The vessel has a bulbous body decorated with floral motifs of leaves and flowers, and three stylized feet that support it. The handle is intricately curved with scrollwork, attached high on the body and sweeping down toward the base. The spout is elongated and curves upwards. The main drawing is set within a large square border in the center of the page. At the lower right, there is a smaller, simplified version of the vessel drawn inside a small square, showing a side view and including scale indicators. The composition is otherwise free of additional objects, and there are a few faint notations and measurement marks near the lower edge.
title: Silver Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
